title: Add representative workload runners and reporting pipeline v4
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: the benchmark lab needs a stable set of representative workload runners and a reporting pipeline that can (1) normalize results across model variants, quantization profiles, and sequence-length distributions, (2) produce daily baselines and profiling artifacts for regression detection, and (3) feed the new perf dashboard. This PR consolidates the workload runner interface, adds v4 representative runners (chat-heavy, summarization, embedding-batch, and streaming short-context), and introduces a first-pass reporting pipeline that generates normalized CSV/JSON artifacts, baseline summaries, and an ingestion job for the perf-dashboard S3 bucket. Changes are grouped: runner refactor, bench harness adapters, profiling baseline collection, reporting ETL, and CI. Testing: unit tests for harness adapters, end-to-end smoke runs against lightweight models in CI, and nightly full runs on the perf-canary infra. Rollout: merged to main behind a feature flag benchlab:v4; nightly job will be enabled after one week of green runs. Follow-ups: add model-version-aware baselines, integrate with SOX alerting for regressions, and add more runner permutations (batched embeddings with cache). Checklist: - [x] Runner interface and adapters - [x] Representative runners implemented - [x] Reporting pipeline (CSV/JSON baseline artifacts) - [x] CI smoke tests - [x] Documentation updates in benchmark-lab/README - [ ] Nightly job enablement (post-merge)
